# Quantum Growth

> Websites, Google Business Profile management and local search for auto shops,
> trades and home services. Nationwide, month to month, and the client owns
> the domain, site, profile and email.

- **Phone:** (916) 868-2447
- **Serves:** United States, remote
- **Model:** Monthly subscription, no contract, cancel any month
- **Annual:** One month free on any plan

## Plans
- **Starter** — $79/month or $869/year, $699 one-time build. 25-page website,
  business email with two mailboxes, social profiles, hosting and maintenance.
- **Local** — $299/month or $3,289/year, build included free. Everything in
  Starter plus managed Google Business Profile, 8 social posts a month,
  citations across 40+ directories, review generation, and a monthly report
  built from Google's own data.
- **Growth** — $599/month or $6,589/year, build included free. Everything in
  Local plus 16 social posts a month, local authority links, two new pages a
  month, and declined-work recovery campaigns.
- **Market Leader** — $1,199/month or $13,189/year, build included free.
  Everything in Growth plus 24 posts a month with video, a page for every
  surrounding town, managed Google Ads or Local Services Ads, and missed-call
  text-back.

## Consulting
- **Visibility Audit** — $499 one-time. Written teardown of map-pack position,
  profile gaps and what the site is missing.
- **Strategy and advisory** — $175/hour, no retainer or minimum.
- **Custom projects** — from $1,500. Booking tools, quote calculators, lead
  routing, AI answering.

## Terms
- No contract. Cancel any month.
- Pause for up to two months a year at $29/month; the site and email stay live.
- Downgrade to a smaller plan at any time.
- Cancellation inside the first six months carries a $100–$500 fee by plan,
  recovering part of the build given free. After six months there is no fee.
- Domain, website, Google Business Profile and email are registered in the
  client's name and stay with them if they leave.

## What every build includes
25 indexable pages, 12 types of structured data, 75 KB total first load, no
external scripts, a full Spanish version, and keyboard and screen-reader
accessibility throughout.
